text: In cellular, we have specific procedures to handle users that move from a base station to another, that allow our users to remain connected with the cellular core without experiencing large disruption times. The procedure, according to which a user moves from one base station to another or from one one point of access to another, is called handoff or handover. And in cellular, we have specific procedures to handle this event efficiently, very efficient, so that the user cannot perceive the fact that its connection switches from one base station to another. So in terms of mobility support, we say that Wi-Fi is good for as we were saying nomadic mobility users that remain static or move slowly for a long time, while cellular networks are also able to support users who move quite fast.
